convention: positive = output is genuinely publishable (golden); negative = output carries an induced defect (canary)

agrees_with_good_work.what: how often the gate lets genuinely publishable coach output through

catches_induced_defects.what: how often the gate blocks output carrying a deliberately injected fault

instrument: the BLOCKING coach quality gate (ADR-108) as it actually ships: deterministic number-grounding prepass + LLM judge

reasons: The boundary region is empty. 0 of 45 labeled cases score within ±15 of the threshold (45–75); the floor is 10. Observed scores straddle the threshold with a 40-point hole in between (nothing between 42 and 82). A margin width fitted here is fitted to no data.

None of the judge's 2 observed errors is a boundary error. The nearest (training_01, false_flag_on_good_work, score 42) sits 18 points from the threshold. A band around the threshold would therefore change the gate's behaviour without preventing a single failure this corpus has ever seen.

The only band the evidence motivates is [42, 60], fitted to n=1 rescued golden(s) — an overfit by inspection. 0 of 15 labeled defects score inside this band. Zero observed leaks is NOT zero leakage: the 95% upper bound on the leaked share is 0.2039 — up to 20% of defects could land inside a band this gate would stop hard-blocking. A gate that stops hard-blocking a band which may contain a fifth of all defects is not a safer gate.

Both classes are polar BY CONSTRUCTION — the goldens were hand-authored to be obviously publishable and the canaries to carry an obvious injected fault. Neither was sampled from the borderline drafts a margin exists to protect, so no amount of re-running this corpus populates the boundary region.
margin.what_would_change_this: Labeled BORDERLINE drafts — at least 10 coach outputs whose true quality is genuinely arguable, scored by the judge, with Matthew's pass/fail label. Real held drafts are the natural source: they are borderline by definition. They are not retained today (coach_quality_gate performs no put_item), so this needs a retention change first, not another run.

must_ship_with: These are the COMBINED gate's rates, not the LLM judge's own discrimination: 12 of the 15 blocking decisions came from a deterministic arithmetic check that runs before the model.
The negatives are hand-authored faults of known classes, not a sample of the defects real generation produces. This does not generalise to field failure modes.
The positives were authored to be obviously clean, so 'agrees with good work' measures the easy half of the job and says nothing about borderline drafts.
A point-in-time measurement of one model version, not a running average. See the re-evaluation cadence in tests/fixtures/golden_briefs/README.md.

separability.note: Catching canary_vendor_leak (score 92) requires a threshold above it, which would also hold 30 of 30 genuinely good drafts. PASS_SCORE_THRESHOLD has no setting that buys this defect back at an acceptable price — the fix is rubric coverage, not tuning.
